general.q: Which Norwegian explorer led the first expedition to reach the South Pole in December 1911?
general.why: Amundsen reached the South Pole on 14 December 1911, five weeks before Robert Falcon Scott.

general.q: Which chemical element has the symbol Au on the periodic table?
general.why: The symbol Au comes from 'aurum', the Latin word for gold, which translates to 'shining dawn'.

general.q: Which fortified wine is produced exclusively in the Douro Valley region of northern Portugal?
general.why: Port has been produced in the Douro Valley since the 17th century and is named after the city of Porto.

general.q: What is the smallest bone in the human body, located inside the middle ear?
general.why: Also known as the stirrup, the stapes measures just 3 millimetres long.

general.q: On which planet in our solar system is Olympus Mons, the largest volcano known to science?
general.why: Olympus Mons on Mars is about two and a half times the height of Mount Everest.

pop.q: In the classic BBC sitcom The Young Ones, what was the name of Vyvyan's pet hamster?
pop.why: SPG stands for Special Patrol Group, named after an infamous Metropolitan Police branch.

pop.q: In the classic video game Street Fighter II, which country does the green-skinned fighter Blanka represent?
pop.why: Blanka survived a plane crash in the Amazon jungle, developing his electric powers there.

pop.q: In Masters of the Universe, what is the name of He-Man's cowardly pet green tiger before he transforms?
pop.why: When He-Man uses the Power of Grayskull, Cringer transforms into the mighty Battle Cat.

pop.q: Which actress starred alongside Anthony Head in the famous 1980s and 90s Nescafé Gold Blend TV adverts?
pop.why: The serialized romance storyline between the neighbours ran for 12 popular episodes over five years.

pop.q: In the 1997 sci-fi comedy Men in Black, what is the official name of the shiny silver device used to erase memories?
pop.why: Agents J and K use the red-flashing Neuralyzer to keep alien encounters secret from the public.

music.q: Which album by Adele became the fastest-selling album in UK chart history upon its release in 2015?
music.why: Adele's '25' sold over 800,000 copies in its first week in the UK, breaking record after record.

music.q: Which filmmaker directed the 1994 music video for Weezer's 'Buddy Holly', integrating the band into scenes from Happy Days?
music.why: Spike Jonze seamlessly inserted Weezer into original footage from the classic 1970s TV show Happy Days.

music.q: What was the title of Keane's hit debut studio album, released in 2004?
music.why: 'Hopes and Fears' featured hits like 'Somewhere Only We Know' and spent nine weeks at UK Number 1.

music.q: Which singer represented the UK at the 1998 Eurovision Song Contest in Birmingham with the song 'Where Are You?'?
music.why: Imaani finished as runner-up to Israel's Dana International in a thrilling contest held in Birmingham.

music.q: Who replaced Ozzy Osbourne as the lead vocalist of heavy metal band Black Sabbath in 1979?
music.why: Ronnie James Dio joined Black Sabbath and sang on their hit 1980 album 'Heaven and Hell'.

mix.q: Which Scottish rock band had a huge international hit in 1985 with 'Don't You (Forget About Me)'?
mix.why: The song famously featured on the soundtrack to John Hughes's teen movie The Breakfast Club.

mix.q: In the BBC comedy series 'The Office', what is the name of the paper merchant company where David Brent works?
mix.why: The fictional paper merchants were based at the Slough Trading Estate.

mix.q: What is the main gas found inside a standard incandescent light bulb to prevent the filament from burning out?
mix.why: Argon is an unreactive noble gas that stops the tungsten filament from oxidising.

mix.q: In the 1994 film 'Pulp Fiction', what is the name of John Travolta's character?
mix.why: John Travolta earned an Oscar nomination for his portrayal of the hitman Vincent Vega.

mix.q: Which indie band released the UK number one single 'I Bet You Look Good on the Dancefloor' in 2005?
mix.why: It was the debut single from Arctic Monkeys, taken from their record-breaking album Whatever People Say I Am...

mix.q: Which body of water lies between the southern coast of England and the northern coast of France?
mix.why: The English Channel connects the North Sea to the Atlantic Ocean and is crossed by the Channel Tunnel.

mix.q: In the classic BBC comedy 'Dad's Army', what was the catchphrase famously shouted by Captain Mainwaring to Pike?
mix.why: Captain Mainwaring frequently uttered "Stupid boy!" whenever Frank Pike made a silly suggestion.

mix.q: Which female pop group had a major 1998 UK number one hit with the song 'C'est la Vie'?
mix.why: The Irish pop group B*Witched became the youngest Irish group to score a UK number one single with this track.

mix.q: Which traditional Scottish dish is made from sheep's pluck mixed with oats, suet, and spices, encased in a stomach?
mix.why: Haggis is traditionally served with "neeps and tatties" on Burns Night.

mix.q: In the classic 1990s video game series 'Monkey Island', what is the name of the main protagonist?
mix.why: Guybrush Threepwood aspires to become the most notorious pirate in the Caribbean.
